batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: st MS Bisla b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: MS Bisla
batting.dismissal: c MM Patel b PP Ojha

batting.name: JH Kallis
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b DR Smith

balls.text: well bowled to finish off the innings, yorker length, dug out to the off side for a single
room again, this time by moving to the leg side and he smacks it over the bowler, probably not as well timed as he would have liked, to long-on for a single
gives room by moving to the off side, wants to paddle it over fine-leg, misses
quick yorker, on the middle stump, drilled back to the long-on for a single
on his pads, in the block-hole but Sharma gets his pads out of the harm's way and flicks it through short fine-leg for a four!
full-toss on the leg stump, pulls it over to deep square-leg for a single
another yorker length ball, turned into a full-toss, hit it to long-off, but on the bounce and they get only the fourth run of the over there.
outside the off stump, wanted to hit it over the off side, misses, a good over from Lee
short ball, quicker, wanted to pull it over mid-wicket, mistimed, gets a bottom edge back to the bowler, who was away in his follow-through and it goes away for a run to long-on
outside the off stump, Sharma was moving to the off side and attempted to paddle it over the short fine-leg fielder, misses and goes through to the wicket-keeper
he was going outside the off stump, bowled way outside the off stump, adjusts his stroke, plays it over covers for a single
yorker length ball, into the pads of Rohit Sharma, dug out well, scoot off for a run
sweeps it away and that has gone for a six over deep square-leg, this has been an amazing batting, for the second time a bowler's fourth over has gone for aplenty after three decent overs
uses his feet and hits it over extra-cover for a four!
tries to hit it over extra-cover, slashes it, over the extra-cover region for a single
swept away to the deep square-leg for a single
tries to swing it, misses because of the leg-spin and beats him, hits the pads and they get a single
goes down the track and wants to hit it over long-on, gets not too much timing, on some bounces to long-on
full-toss going down the leg side, he was moving to the legs, flicked it away for a single to get to his fifty.
full pitched ball, flicked away to the mid-wicket and that has brought up his maiden IPL century!
down the leg side and that is a wide, thank goodness he did not get any bat on that from Kolkata's perspective, that would have been another four!
four more, flicked over the mid-wicket fielder for four, 99 to Rohit Sharma, this has been an excellent knock on a slow track
full-toss, wanted to play over mid-wicket, does not get any elevation, on the bounce to the fielder, they do not take the run
cut it away for four, this was outside the off stump, slower, shorter and there was no third-man in place, gets a four!
pitched up to the bat and he has smacked it over long-on for a six! What timing, giving himself room, the fielder at the fence tried to jump up and grab it but misses by a decnet distance

bouncer, was it? it was short and bounced up for the batsman to cut away, but he was surprised by that one, lets it go alone and to the keeper. Gibbs was looking for a wide there but it wasn't coming!
another one outside the off stump, quickly turning in, pushes to the off side for a single
swept away this time, through fine-leg for four, the fielder was inside the circle
was shaping the cut and suddenly it turned in so sharply that his bat was miles away from the ball!
slapped away by Gibbs to the deep cover, only a single
short ball from Narine, pulled away to long-on for a single
slower one, short of length and pushed through the covers for a single
down the track, drilled through the extra-cover region for a four, that sped away, gorgeous stroke
pitched up and slogged it over mid-wicket for a six! Sharma was batting really well to begin with and now, he is turning it on.
full toss and swept away over square-leg this time, the fine-leg was back this time and Sharma has hit it squarer for a four!
slower one, outside the off stump, punched to the off side
slower one, on the pads, and swept away over short fine-leg, four!
short of length, flicked to the deep mid-wicket fielder and they are able to come back for the second
pitched up, Gibbs gets some bat, drives but to the covers fielder
on the stumps, turning away from Gibbs, it was shorter, pushed to the covers
quicker and turns as an offie as well, beats Gibbs
tried to reverse sweep it, almost off the back of the bat, missed
outside the off, turning away, bounce and left alone!
and this time, it is pulled over mid-wicket, where the deep square-leg fielder has to rush to field, does a decent job and gets a couple
they are giving themselves room, he does that again and it turns away, hit over extra-cover for a couple
short of length, quicker, room given again and driven through the covers for a single
this time he cuts well, goes to point where Gambhir dives and fields well
floated up, room given and tries to cut, on the bounce to backward point
short of length, gives himself room and cuts through the cover for a single
full-toss this time and pushed to long-on for a single
gives room and bang, over the bowler's head for a six! Bhatia slowed the pace down, Gibbs waited for it and then slammed it for the maximum
yorker length ball, outside the off stump, gets the bat down in time, gets some edge through to short fine-leg for a single
pitched up and wants to drive over extra-cover, mistimed and it falls on the bounce to long-off
length ball, outside the off stump, punched in the air and almost carries to the extra-cover fielder
on the middle stump, short of length, rocks back on his back foot, pushed to square-leg for a single
slower, floated up outside the off stump, wanted to hoick over the mid-wicket region, mistimes the shot and rolls over to square-leg for a single
slower, pitched on the middle and up to the bat, driven through the covers for a single
slower ball, outside the off stump, driven to long-off, almost a check-drive and moves on to 53
pitched up and flicked away to fine-leg, that is so beautifully done, to get to his half-century off only 29 balls.
another bouncer and Sharma was planning to go for it again, but pulls out at the last moment, wide called
short ball from Kallis and that has been absolutely smacked over the mid-wicket for six! That was a good shot but Kallis does not believe so, he is giving them a long stare!
gives room and drills it  back to the bowler, almost through his hands, it was so quick that the hands came in very late, gone for four!
slows the ball down, and pulls his length back, Gibbs needs to wait for it, pushed to the off side
full-toss and Gibbs gives himself room to play it over the bowler's head, easily beats the long-on and long-off
on the pads, slower one as well, wanted to pull it over deep square-leg, misses because of the slowness of the ball, hits the pads
pitched up on the middle, flicked over mid-on for a single
on his pads, length ball, pushed to the deep square-leg fielder for a single
on the middle stump, pitched up to Sharma, who drives well, but straight to the fielder at short cover
on the off stump, moves to the off side and flicked away to the deep square-leg for a single
on the off stump, short of length again, defended on the back foot
flicked away to the fine-leg region for a two, short of length, on the middle stump and works it away well
gives himself room, wanted to go over extra-cover, slows it down, shorter ball, can get it to deep cover for a single
on his pads this time, short of length, flicked away to fine-leg for a single.
outside the off stump and cut away, it was the perfect use of pace, times it through point and to the right of the third-man for four
down his pads, almost a half volley, gets beaten because of the slowness of the delivery, still manages a single to square-leg, the sixth of the over
slower one, short of length, does not comes on to the bat, but Gibbs is able to dab it to square-leg for a single
pitched up to the bat, drilled to long-off for a single
on his pads, Gibbs rolls his wrists over to short fine-leg for a single
on the middle stump, short of length ball, pushed to the mid-wicket for a single
outside the off stump, bit of deviation away from the bat, pushed to the off side
on the stumps, length ball, punched to the leg side and they are off for a quick single.
outside the off stump, short of length again, tries to cut hard but can only stab it into the ground, straight to the cover fielder
gives himself room again, Kallis goes for the bouncer, slightly above Gibbs' head, called a wide
goes down the track quickly, Kallis sees it and pushes it wider of the off stump, gets an inside edge, on the bounce to the wicket-keeper
slower bouncer, Sharma was aiming for the pull, but the slowness of the delivery almost beat him, rolls his wrists over for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, punched through the point region for a run, third-man tidies up
on the off stump, punched to the off side for a quick single
pitched right up and Gibbs has swept him away, almost like he was eyeing that gap between long-on and square-leg, goes for four!
short of length again, quicker, pushed over to long-on for another run
change in the run-up, a tad shorter, pushed to long-on for a single
on the middle, length ball, did not know where it was turning, pushes it to the leg side
outside the off stump, slight turn, pushed to the off side
outside the off stump, pitched right up, driven to mid-off
and after the dot comes the boundary, a six this time! There were six players on the off side and Rohit heaves a full pitched ball over mid-wicket for a maximum and that brings 14 in the over
goes down the track, Shakib slows it down, he tries to push it long-on for a single, but Shakib comes over and fields
blazed away, quicker, fuller and Sharma throws his bat at it, sizzles through the covers for another four!
on the back foot, hit back to the right of the bowler, who fields
well bowled from Shakib but Rohit Sharma stopped his shot, goes back and cuts it really late through the covers for a four
slows it down, outside the off stump, defended to the off side
in the block-hole, pitched right up, Gibbs was giving himself room, drives it but straight to covers
edged and four, almost deliberate. He gave himself room to the one outside the off stump, length ball, there was no third-man, sliced it away to third-man
outside the off stump, length ball, punched to wide mid-off and immediately off for a single
short ball and that has been hooked away for six, the first of the day! He was looking a tad fidgety earlier too, Lee bowled a decent bouncer there but pulled really well over square-leg
length ball, on the off stump, quicker ball, defended by Sharma
yorker-length, on the middle stump, he had his foot out, quickly jabs his bat down and defends
outside the off stump, takes his front foot forward and defends to the off side
over the top and that goes to wide long-off for a couple, this is good shot-making from Gibbs, it was flighted as well and Gibbs decided to take the arial route
flighted, inside out from Rohit Sharma, goes straight to long-off on the bounce, he will be happy to get away after that last game duck
angling in, flighted in, defends and an inside edge to the square-leg

gone, is it? Tossed up, turning a tad away from Tendulkar, this was one of the first few that turned, Tendulkar was beaten by the spin, Bisla flicks the bail off and it looks like Tendulkar had his foot in the air. Yes it is, gone, out, stumped, a big wicket and the crowd is on their feet!
on his pads, flicked away to the the front of square and by the time the fielder from deep square-leg could come across, they are off for a couple
and again, down the pitch, converts the good length delivery into an overpitched one and crashes it over the cover boundary, that has gone on the bounce into the fence.
shot, aggressive from Gibbs, inside out to a ball that was pitched up and that races over the extra-cover region for a boundary
opens the face of the bat, pushes to the off side, was a short of length ball and straight to point
pitched up, 142.1 km/hr, gives himself room, caresses it through the covers and that pierces the in-field
length ball again, on the off stump, opens the face of the bat to point, to the fielder and that is the seventh dot ball of the match. Out of eight.
short of length, 139.2 km/hr, defended back to the bowler
on his pads, quicker, tapped away to square-leg for a single
round the wicket, length ball, defended the ball back to the bowler
again angled in, this time going down the leg side, tries to sweep, missed
comes in with the arm, defended, hits the pads and an appeal from the wicket-keeper
quicker, length ball, outside the off stump, left alone
flighted, round the wicket, angles in and taps it away to the off side
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and edged away to the third-man for four!
gone, caught at extra-cover! Full-toss and Kallis tries to clear the extra-cover region and hits it straight to the fielder
shortish from the bowler, he finally unleashes a pull and that beats the fielders at long-on and deep square-leg
reverse sweep attempted but the ball came on very slow, missed by Kallis
yorker, flicked it away to fine-leg for a single
full toss, lifted but only on the bounce to long-on for a single
another one pitched right up to the bat, driven to the long-on for fielder
yes, it is at the same place called the blockhole and the result is the same, a single, driven to long-on.
another yorker, he is doling them out as complimentary presents, the batsman gets an inside edge and it is a run to the total. Only one.
in the block-hole yet again, drilled away to the deep mid-wicket fielder for a single

slower from Malinga, shorter as well, Kallis expected it to be a full length ball and that is probably why he went for the reverse flick, but the ball never came on and he gets it away to the off side
well bowled, yorker length ball into his legs and all he can do is to nudge it to the leg side
slower one, on the middle, pitched up and lofted over the bowler's head for a six, making it a 15-run over
full-toss and whacked it over the cover region, by the time Rayadu came over to stop that, they are able to come back for the second
outside the off stump, moves towards the off stump, uses the pace to paddle it over fine-leg
full-toss, on the middle, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single
on the middle stump, driven to the long-off for a single
pitched up in the block-hole, wanted to hit it over long-on but the drive goes to long-on
pitched up, outside the off stump, drilled it over to wide long-off but only for a single
shorter, slower and he wanted to hoick it over long-on, for the second time in the over, he hits it on the bounce to long-on
pitched up into the blockhole and that has been hit away to long-off, required rate to 18.
slower and shorter, wanted to pull it away, can get it away on the bounce to long-on
quicker ball, yorker length, and well drilled to deep square-leg but only for a couple, however, had that hit the stumps direct from the deep, he would have been out!
slower one, shorter as well and he tries to whack it away, but can only get it to deep mid-wicket for a single

that has been scooped over the short fine-leg for a four, on the off stump, right up to the bat and Kallis manages to get it over the fielder, 11 off the over, which is still lesser than the require-rate
another yorker length ball and all he can do is to dig it out to the leg side for a single
finally, finally a four, short arm flick, no follow through of the bat, there was no fielder at deep mid-wicket and a four!
another one pitched right up to the bat, he is just not able to get them away, straight to mid-wicket
on the middle stump, yorker length ball, driven to the wide long-off for a single, they wanted the second, but well done by Pollard
yorker length, down the leg side, there was some appeal there for reasons unknown, they are off for a single
slower one, pitched right up to the batsman, goes for a drive and gets it in the middle too, but it hits the stumps at the non-striker's end!
length ball, he was lining up to pull it some place but can only punch it to the long-on fielder for a single
pitched up, slower again, slogged away to deep mid-wicket and there is a fielder there, only a single
shorter ball from Pollard, rolls his fingers over it, outside the off stump, smashes but straight to the fielder at deep covers
shorter ball, slower, pulled away to deep square-leg region for a single
on his pads yet again, off-break probably, wanted to flick it over deep square-leg but gets only an inside edge
slower one, down the leg side, does not get any bat on it after walking across, wide called
another yorker length ball on his pads, tries to flick it through short fine-leg but goes straight to the fielder
yorker length yet again, swings into the bat, quick too, flicked away to mid-wicket and Munaf fields it on the bounce
yorker, again swinging into the bat, gets the bat down in time, gets to long-on for a single
full-toss, attempted yorker, flicked away well, Gibbs at deep square-leg slides and stops it, only a couple
yorker length ball again, darting into the bat, gets some bat on that one, they are able to come back for a couple of runs
pitched up to the bat, slower, plays it back to the bowler
pitched up in the hitting area for the batsman, wanted to go over long-on, does not get any elevation, played to long-on for a single
another full-toss and it was nearly above the waist again! Not called a no-ball this and so Smith can continue bowling, tapped away to the off side for a run
short ball and pulled away by Kallis to the deep square-leg for a four! Smith is not amused with Munaf's effort, but he was never going to get there.
full-toss and over the waist height, almost hits Pathan, who pulls it away to square-leg for a single
short ball, outside the off stump and it almost looked like a mishit, and still guess where it goes, four to long-off!
in the block-hole, on the middle stump, driven to long-on for a single
outside the off stump, pitched up, driven to extra-cover
driven to the off side, quick single taken and that is 15 runs in that over, movement in the right direction
over the wicket, outside the leg stump, spinning well, tries to sweep and it goes in front of the square
outside the off stump, pitched up and smash! Over long-off for the second six of the over!
down the wicket again, pushes it shorter, flicked away to deep mid-wicket for a single
again, almost down the track, before realising he was going to miss it, and he pushes his foot back
down the pitch and smack! Six over the bowler's head, that is not such a good welcome!
pitched full, on the off stump, wants to go over the top, but can get it only as far as the long-on fielder
played away to the leg side for a single
pitched right up drilled back to the bowler, misfield allows it to go to the long-on for a single
outside the off stump, wanted to hit it over long-off for a single
length ball on the middle stump, pushed to extra-cover for a single
quickish one, right in the block-hole, drilled to long-off for a single
outside the off stump, cut away to third-man for a single
outside the off stump, slower, pitched up, driven to point

he was walking towards the off side, the shuffle cost him his wicket, hits his pads and the umpire rules his out. The ball was probably moving down, coming in with the angle, he bowled that from wide of the crease and hit the pads on the middle
moves away, tries to play it through the covers, but is only able to push it to backward point
inside edge and goes for a four to fine-leg, slower ball, probably a knuckle ball, the keeper was up and he could not get down in time
cross-batted mow from Tiwary and that beats the mid-wicket fielder, it was a slower ball and read well!
outside the off stump, tad slower, he tries to guide it through third-man but goes to Munaf at short third-man and they get no run
pitched up, dug out well, to short third man for a single
short of length again and this time it has been cut away to point for a single
outside the off stump, tries to cut it away, misses and the keeper up to the stumps, collects
outside the off stump, short of good length, defended
on the middle stump, angling in, he tried to flick it away, gets a top edge and it loops up to square-leg, but there is no fielder there
moves around in the crease, but comes back to his original position, opens the face of the bat again and that is dabbed away to short third-man
outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and pushes to the covers for a single
pitched right up to the bat, pushed firmly to the wide long-off region for a single
pulled away for a four! That was a shorter one from Pollard, there was no pace on it, he had ample time it rock back and smack it away for a four!
short of length, defended on the off side for a single, the bowler runs to the ball and fields
outside the off stump, punched to the point fielder, moves to his left and fields
shot, swept away, six! This time he did not move too much and smashed it over deep square-leg for a six, just over the fielder there and some move on.
short ball, gives room by moving to the leg stump,drives well to the cover fielder
this time on the middle stump, pitched up, tries another sweep, gets some bat to short fine-leg where they get a run
outside the leg stump, going with the arm, tries to sweep, straight to the short fine-leg fielder
short of length, wanted to go back and flick it away, misses, goes through for a single
round the wicket, outside the off stump, turning into the batsman, hits the pads
and he goes down the pitch yet again and this time he is able to clear the mid-on fielder for a four, that is his first four.
shortens his length, defended on the leg side
goes down the track and chips it over mid-wicket, square-leg comes over and gets a couple
on the off stump, turning away from the bat, tapped to the off side
outside the off stump, on the back foot, defended to point
turns away, played to push it to point for a single
short of length, outside the off stump, deviates slightly away from the batsman, misses and the keeper collects.
drifted on to his pads, but isn't able to get the gap with the fielder up at short fine-leg, single for the all-rounder
on the off stump,pitched up, slightly quicker from Munaf and Kallis hits it cleanly over the bowler, to long-off for a four!
short of length, on the middle stump, he is able to nudge it away to the deep fielder on the leg side for a single
slowed delivery, the wicket-keeper continues to remain up to the stumps, length ball, defended back to the bowler
on the off stump, pitched right up to the bat, driven to mid-off for a single
and another one in the block-hole, Kallis gets his bat down and flicks it away to the mid-on for a single
yorker length, he was moving to the off side and jabbed his bat on it, had he missed it, it could have been caught him plumb in front, instead he gets a single
short of length on his pads, nudged to deep square-leg for a single
slower one, wanted to go over mid-wicket, it has turned and hit the back pad, huge appeal from Malinga and the umpire says not-out. Probably going down..but wow that turned!
bouncer to follow up the slower one, it did not rise up too much but Tiwary was on the front foot and with much difficulty goes under it
slower ball outside the off stump, Tiwary was sucked into trying to hit it over the extra-cover, misses, through to the keeper
outside edge I think, hits Karthik's pads, length ball, was attempting to hit it on the up
driven through the covers for a four! pitched up a little, slower, Kallis goes down the track and that is an expansive drive for four!
outside the off stump, on the good length, driven to the off side and it goes to the covers
short ball this time and he walks into it and pulls it over mid-wicket for a four!
gives himself room, Munaf saw that and slowed it down, almost floats it up on the middle stump and Kallis can only drive it to the covers
on the middle stump, pushed back to the bowler, not too much pace on that one
on to the back foot, pushed it to the covers and to the fielder
slows it down, turn from short of length, he was shaping to cut it away, misses
quicker ball, on the off side, driven down for a single
pitched up, drilled to the cover fielder and done well by Harbhajan, no run
sweep, top-edge and caught! Quicker one, he tried to slog it away, gets a top-edge to the short fine-leg fielder for a simple catch (made look a tad tougher!) for Munaf
on the off stump, punched to the off side, goes to long-off for a single
on the middle stump, length ball, pushed to mid-on for a single
outside the off stump, short of length, keeps a tad low, misses the cut shot
outside the off stump, thought it would angle into the bat, moves away from him and misses the outside edge
gone, bowled, middle peg is on the floor! It was slower, he was giving himself room and misses, and the skipper is on his way back!
outside the edge, was cutting it, the keeper was up to the stumps and he has spilled it! Tough chance because of the deviation but dropped!
on the off stump, deviating away, pushed away to the off side for a quickly taken run
